## Selected technical and research projects

### Computational Stability of Cubical Homology

*Final-year BSc dissertation, University of Bristol · 2026 · Mark: 90%*

I developed and tested a reproducible, parallelised Python pipeline for
cubical persistent homology on 400 retinal images across ten perturbation
protocols and 170 settings, separating spatial misalignment from sensor
corruption for fault isolation in human-led diagnostic workflows.

[View the public dissertation and implementation](https://github.com/reyjosephnieto/ph).

### Cryptographic Implementation and Security Analysis

*Vigenère–RSA with bigram encoding · Second-year BSc Python project, University
of Bristol · 2024*

I built and stress-tested a Python implementation combining RSA key exchange
with randomised bigram encoding and documented weaknesses arising from design
and implementation choices.

### Sovereign-Investment Safeguards Analysis

*Foundation Certificate extended project, Kaplan International College London ·
2023*

I synthesised legal, economic, and public-source evidence to compare proposed
safeguards for the Philippine Maharlika Investment Fund with institutional
failures identified in the 1MDB case. Kaplan selected the paper as an anonymised
model for future cohorts.
